fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $49,900 (lump sum, fully earned and non-refundable). Reduced to $35,000 for existing franchisees opening a second or subsequent Store. Waived entirely for approved conversions of existing retail pet stores (provided required signage is ordered at signing). WNW employees pay a reduced fee of $10,000 ($5,000 at signing, $5,000 at lease execution) — this is the lowest disclosed fee and sets the low end of the range. Veterans (VetFran) receive a 20% discount on the standard fee (applicable to first franchise only, not combinable with other discounts). First responders receive a 10% discount (applicable to first franchise only, not combinable). Multi-Unit Agreement fee is $49,900 for the first Store plus $35,000 for each additional Store; no additional fee is charged at individual Franchise Agreement signing under a Multi-Unit Agreement. A separate $20,000 Grand Opening advertising fee and a $15,000 Set Up Fee are also collected before opening but are not part of the Initial Franchise Fee itself.
raw_excerpt:
You must pay WNW a lump sum initial franchise fee of $49,900 when you sign the Franchise Agreement (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). If you already operate a retail pet store that we approve for conversion to a Wag N Wash Store, we will waive the Initial Franchise Fee provided that you order all required signage at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement.

The initial franchise fee is fully earned and non-refundable when paid. We have the right to offer a discounted Initial Franchise Fee from time to time. If you are an existing franchisee, we will reduce the Initial Franchise Fee to $35,000 for the second and any subsequent Stores you open.

WNW is a member of the International Franchise Association ("IFA") and participates in the IFA's VetFran Program, which provides a 20% discount on the Initial Franchise Fee to honorably discharged veterans of U.S. Armed Forces who otherwise meet the requirements of the VetFran program.

WNW offers current and former first responders who otherwise meet the requirements for a WNW franchise a 10% discount on the Initial Franchise Fee...

If you are an employee of WNW, you will be eligible for a reduced initial franchise fee of $10,000, of which $5,000 is paid contemporaneously with the execution of the Franchise Agreement, and the remaining $5,000 is payable at the time you execute a lease for your Store ("Employee Initial Franchise Fee").
